reason: low CPU utilisation caused by overly conservative scheduler

model_family_concurrency_caps.catboost: derived from observed peak RSS plus 25 percent safety factor
model_family_concurrency_caps.xgboost: derived from observed peak RSS plus 25 percent safety factor

memory_pressure_rules.scale_up_requires: available RAM > max(24 GB, 25% total RAM), commit < 75% limit, no pagefile growth
memory_pressure_rules.scale_down_when: available RAM < max(16 GB, 15% total RAM), commit > 85% limit, pagefile grows > 1 GB, OOM, or thrashing
memory_pressure_rules.launch_gate: fit-process RSS + expected peak RSS + 16 GB reserve must fit safely within commit capacity

disk_pressure_rules.scale_up_requires: disk active time not sustained above 90% and no artifact write backlog
disk_pressure_rules.scale_down_when: disk active time sustained above 95% with increasing queue or delayed atomic writes

retry_rules: same digest-valid inputs; at most three consecutive failures per canonical unit; failed attempts quarantined; no result selection
